title: Connect All Hostels
statement: A campus wants to lay network cables so that all n hostels are connected. Each possible cable connects two hostels at a cost. Find the minimum total cost that connects every hostel.
input_format: The first line contains n and m. Each of the next m lines has u, v and cost.
output_format: Print the minimum total cost, or -1 if the hostels cannot all be connected.

examples.explanation: Using costs 1, 3 and 2 connects all four hostels for 6.

hints: You need exactly n - 1 cables that join all hostels with no cycle.
Consider cables from cheapest to most expensive and skip any that would form a cycle.
A disjoint-set (union-find) structure checks cycles quickly; totals may exceed 32 bits.
